provenance.capture_method: POST /search and /evaluate; unedited response.json() objects after raise_for_status(). No server was started.
provenance.scope: Nominal isolated-transmon model responses for integration tests. Not experimental device data; no stress, lifetime, or yield model.
provenance.recipe: Capture 401-point 10 kHz search; freeze its selected EJ/EC/ng/ncut. Capture 1 kHz, 1 kHz with 300 MHz minimum, and 6 GHz with 1 kHz searches with that baseline. Evaluate each distinct selected candidate.
provenance.response_note: Each searches value is the complete actual HTTP JSON response, including its normalized request. Evaluations are complete actual /evaluate HTTP JSON responses keyed by selected candidate_id.
